posts.t: #SJSharks Askarov on his incredible save: "That's a super quick play. I know I was late, and I was like, 'Just dive to the right side. I did a big exhale after that. I was like, "Ooh, thank God, it is in the glove."

Collin Graf and Yaroslav Askarov led the #SJSharks to their first regulation win of the season. Read the recap on Sharks Hockey Digest.
